help.short: The name of the Data Lake Analytics account.
The name of the firewall rule to create or update.
The end IP address for the firewall rule. This can be either ipv4 or ipv6. Start and End should be in the same protocol.
The start IP address for the firewall rule. This can be either ipv4 or ipv6. Start and End should be in the same protocol.
The firewall rule properties to use when creating a new firewall rule.

description: Create the specified firewall rule. During update, the firewall rule with the specified name will be replaced with this new firewall rule.
